paragraphs: Orion S.A. ("Orion", "Company", "we" or "our"), is a Luxembourg joint stock corporation (société anonyme or S.A.), incorporated in 2014 as a Luxembourg limited liability company (société à responsabilité limitée). Our registered office is located at 6, Route de Trèves, L-2633 Senningerberg (Municipality of Niederanven), Grand Duchy of Luxembourg. Our principal executive office is located in Spring, Texas, U.S.

We are one of the largest global producers of Specialty and Rubber Carbon Black. Carbon black is a powdered form of carbon that is used to create a variety of desired physical, electrical and optical qualities of various materials. Carbon black products are primarily used as additives for the production of polymers, batteries, printing inks and coatings ("Specialty Carbon Black" or "Specialty") and in the reinforcement of tires and other rubber applications ("Rubber Carbon Black" or "Rubber"). Our core competencies include the ability to engineer the physical properties of carbon black to meet the functional needs of our customers.

We currently operate 14 wholly owned production facilities, excluding the under-construction facility at La Porte, Texas, in Europe, North and South America, South Africa, and Asia, and one jointly-owned production facility at Dortmund, Germany. Our headquarters in Luxembourg, we have our principal executive office in Spring, Texas (U.S.), as well as offices in Frankfurt (Germany), Cologne (Germany), Shanghai (China), Seoul (South Korea), Tokyo (Japan), Sao Paolo (Brazil) and other locations. Our principal research and development ("R&D") center is located in Cologne (Germany). We also have laboratories to support our customers in Carlstadt, New Jersey (U.S.), Shanghai (China) and Yeosu (South Korea).

We are a premium supplier of carbon black generating long-term benefits for stakeholders while remaining committed to responsible business practices with a focus on team culture, reliability, quality and sustainability.
Our business is organized into two reportable segments: Specialty Carbon Black and Rubber Carbon Black. Our business segments are discussed in more detail later in this section.

Our internet address is www.orioncarbons.com. We make available, free of charge on or through our website, our current Annual Reports in Form 10-K, Quarterly Reports in Form 10-Q, reports in Form 8-K and amendments to those reports filed or furnished pursuant to Section 13(a) or 15(d) of the Exchange Act as soon as reasonably practicable after electronically filing such material with, or furnishing it to, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission ("SEC"). Information appearing on our website is not a part of, and is not incorporated in, this Annual Report in Form 10-K.

Carbon black is manufactured in a highly controlled process to produce particles and aggregates of varied structure and surface chemistry, resulting in many different performance characteristics for a wide variety of applications.

The Company manufactures Specialty Carbon Black for a broad range of specialized applications such as polymers, batteries, printing and coatings. The various production processes result in a wide range of different Specialty Carbon Black grades with respect to their primary particle size, structure, surface area and surface chemistry. These parameters affect jetness, tinting strength, undertone, dispersibility, electrical conductivity and other characteristics. Carbon black is an additive that enhances the physical, electrical and optical properties of our customers' end products.

We have several post-treated Specialty Carbon Black grades for coatings and printing applications, as well as several high purity carbon black grades for the fiber industry and conductive carbon black grades for batteries, polymers and coatings. Our specialty grades of carbon black are used to impart color, provide rheology control, enhance conductivity and static charge control, provide UV protection, enhance mechanical properties and provide formulation flexibility through surface treatment. These specialty carbon products are used in a wide variety of applications, such as coatings, inks, plastics, adhesives, toners and batteries.

Carbon Black for Coatings—We offer a broad range of Specialty Carbon Black products for coatings, which includes products used for pigmentation and protection (e.g., automotive base coats and architectural coatings), for conductivity and for tinting, as well as for paints and for light tinting in transparent coatings (e.g., metallic effects and wood glazing). The diversity of our manufacturing processes allows for the creation of a wide range of Specialty Carbon Black grades with different structures and chemical properties, thereby allowing our products to impart unique characteristics to our customers' products.

Carbon Black for Polymers—We offer Specialty Carbon Black for polymers in a diverse range of end markets, including pipe (e.g., gas, oil, municipal water, sewage), construction, energy distribution (e.g., power cables), automotive, agriculture and consumer packaging. Certain products within this portfolio provide UV protection against polymer degradation for material such as pipe used for potable

water, injection molding, agriculture films and cables. Other products include standard- to high-performance grades designed and modified to provide electrical conductivity, antistatic and reinforcing properties to many different polymer applications, including high-voltage cables, film and high-pressure pipes.

Carbon Black for Printing—We offer Specialty Carbon Black for printing inks used in different printing systems and applications. We apply different process technologies to offer highly specialized products meeting specific requirements, including compliance with food-contact regulations and specially formulated products that require unique attributes such as color undertone, optical density and gloss.

Carbon Black for Batteries—We offer conductive additives for lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles, energy storage and consumer applications. They can be used both in the cathode and anode. We also offer conductive additives for lead-acid batteries, supercapacitors and dry cell batteries. Our products, which are manufactured in different production processes, are differentiated by high purity, high conductivity, low moisture and easy dispersion, enhancing the performance, lifetime and safety of batteries.

paragraphs: The following risks may have material adverse effects on our business, financial condition and results of operations. Additional risks and uncertainties of which we are not presently aware or that we currently deem immaterial could also materially affect our business operations and financial condition.

Our operations and performance are materially connected to worldwide economic conditions. Because carbon black is used in a diverse array of end products, demand for carbon black has historically been related to real gross domestic product ("GDP") and general global economic conditions. In particular, a large part of our sales has direct exposure to the cyclical automotive industry and, to a lesser extent, the construction industry. As a result, certain parts of our business experience a level of cyclicality. The nature of our business and our large fixed asset base make it difficult to rapidly adjust our fixed costs downward when demand for our products declines, which could materially affect our profitability. Global and regional economic downturns have in the past, and may in the future, reduce demand or pricing for our products, which have decreased and would decrease our revenue, and could have a material adverse effect on our business,

financial condition, results of operations and cash flows. In periods with significant market turmoil or tightened credit availability, we could experience difficulties in accounts receivable collections, pricing pressures and reduced global or local business activity.

Our customers may terminate or attempt to amend their agreements for the purchase of our products due to decline in their demand and production, bankruptcy, lack of liquidity, lack of funding, operational failures, force majeure, hardship or other reasons. The current energy, financial, economic and capital markets environment, and future developments in these and other areas, present material uncertainty and risk with respect to our performance, financial condition, volume of business, results of operations and cash flows.

Our operations in the EU are material to our business and important to our customers. If the competitiveness of manufacturing in the EU continues to decrease in light of factors such as increased environmental compliance costs, inconsistent economic policies and rigid labor practices, our customers may have difficulty maintaining the competitiveness of their operations in this region or lose meaningful market share to lower cost imports from other regions, particularly Asia. For example, a shift in tire production from a higher cost region (such as the EU) to a lower cost region (such as Asia) could increase the export of tires made in Asia for sales into Europe and could result in a reduction in tire production in the EU and reduce our profitability.

In addition, changes in, or tensions relating to, U.S. or other countries' trade relations with countries where we do business or from which we source necessary supplies may adversely impact our business. The imposition of additional restrictive policies by individual countries could lead to unexpected operating difficulties in countries we operate in or do business with. Further changes and uncertainty in the geopolitical environment or government policy, including actual or threatened measures such as tariffs, counter-tariffs and other trade barriers, have and may continue to have impacts on global markets and foreign exchange rates. Any of these could increase our costs and negatively impact our financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.

paragraphs: Orion S.A. ("Orion", "Company", "we" or "our"), 為一 Luxembourg 股份有限公司 (société anonyme 或 S.A.), 於 2014 年設立為 Luxembourg 有限責任公司 (société à responsabilité limitée). 我們的登記事務所位於 6, Route de Trèves, L-2633 Senningerberg (Municipality of Niederanven), Grand Duchy of Luxembourg. 我們的主要營運事務所位於 Texas, U.S. Spring.

我們為全球最大的 Specialty 及 Rubber Carbon Black 生產商之一。Carbon black 為一種粉末狀碳，用以創造各種材料所需的物理、電氣及光學特性。Carbon black 產品主要作為添加劑，用於生產聚合物、電池、印刷油墨及塗料 ("Specialty Carbon Black" 或 "Specialty")，並用於橡膠應用的增強，如輪胎及其他橡膠應用 ("Rubber Carbon Black" 或 "Rubber"). 我們的核心競爭力包括能工程化碳黑的物理特性，以符合客戶的功能需求。

我們目前運作 14 個全資擁有之生產設施，不計正在建設中的 Texas La Porte 設施，於歐洲、北美、南美、南非及亞洲運作，並於 Germany Dortmund 有一個共同擁有之生產設施。我們的 Luxembourg 董事會，我們的主要營運事務所位於 Texas, U.S. Spring，並於 Frankfurt (Germany), Cologne (Germany), Shanghai (China), Seoul (South Korea), Tokyo (Japan), Sao Paolo (Brazil) 及其他地點設有辦事處。我們的主要研究與發展 ("R&D") 中心位於 Cologne (Germany). 我們亦於 Carlstadt, New Jersey (U.S.), Shanghai (China) 及 Yeosu (South Korea) 設有實驗室，以支援客戶。
我們為碳黑的高階供應商，能為股東創造長期效益，同時致力於負責任的商業實踐，注重團隊文化、可靠性、品質及永續性。
我們的業務分為兩個應報告分部：Specialty Carbon Black 及 Rubber Carbon Black。我們的業務分部於本節後續有更詳細說明。

我們的網站地址為 www.orioncarbons.com。我們於網站上免費提供現行年度報告 (Form 10-K)、季報 (Form 10-Q)、Form 8-K 報告及這些報告的更正版本，這些報告根據證券交易法第 13(a) 或 15(d) 節規定，於電子提交後盡速提供給美國證券交易委員會 ("SEC"). 網站上的資訊並非本年度報告 (Form 10-K) 的一部分，亦未被納入本年度報告中。
Carbon black 透過高度控制的製造過程製造，以產生不同結構及表面化學的粒子及聚集體，從而產生許多不同性能特徵，適用於廣泛的應用。
本公司製造用於廣泛專用應用的 Specialty Carbon Black，如聚合物、電池、印刷及塗料。不同的生產過程會產生不同級別的 Specialty Carbon Black，根據其主要粒子大小、結構、表面積及表面化學特性。這些參數會影響_jetness_、著色強度、底色、分散性、電導率及其他特性。Carbon black 是一種添加劑，能增強我們客戶終端產品的物理、電氣及光學特性。
本公司擁有數種經過後處理的特種碳黑等級，用於塗料與印刷應用，以及數種高純度碳黑等級用於纖維產業，以及用於電池、聚合物與塗料的導電碳黑等級。本公司特種碳黑等級用於賦予色彩、提供流變控制、增強導電性與靜電控制、提供紫外線防護、增強機械性質，並透過表面處理提供配方靈活性。這些特種碳黑產品用於廣泛的應用，例如塗料、油墨、塑膠、黏合劑、碳粉與電池。
用於塗料的碳黑—本公司提供廣泛的特種碳黑產品用於塗料，包括用於著色與防護（例如汽車底漆與建築塗料）、用於導電性與調色，以及用於塗料與透明塗料中的輕度調色（例如金屬效果與木紋塗裝）。本公司製造工藝的多樣性允許製造不同結構與化學性質的特種碳黑等級，因此本公司產品可賦予客戶產品獨特的特性。
用於聚合物的碳黑—本公司提供用於聚合物的特種碳黑，應用於多種最終市場，包括管線（例如天然氣、石油、市區用水、汙水）、建設、能源分配（例如電力電纜）、汽車、農業與消費性包裝。此產品組閤中的某些產品可為用於飲用水管線、注射成型、農業薄膜與電纜等材料提供紫外線防護，防止聚合物劣化。
其他產品包括標準至高性能等級，經過設計與改良以提供許多不同聚合物應用的電導性、抗靜電與增強性質，包括高壓電纜、薄膜與高壓管線。
用於印刷的碳黑—本公司提供用於印刷油墨的特種碳黑，應用於不同印刷系統與應用。本公司運用不同製程技術，提供高度專業化產品以符合特定需求，包括符合食品接觸規範與需要獨特特性（例如色彩底調、光密度與光澤）的特別配方產品。
用於電池的碳黑—本公司提供用於電動車、能源儲存與消費性應用的鋰離子電池導電添加劑，可用於陽極與陰極。本公司也提供用於鉛酸電池、超電容與乾電池的導電添加劑。本公司產品透過不同製造工藝製造，以高純度、高導電性、低濕度與易分散性為特色，提升電池的性能、壽命與安全性。

paragraphs: 下列討論與分析總結了影響我們在2025年及2024年12月31日財務年度營運結果與財務狀況的重要因素，請與本年度年報中所載之第1項「業務」及第8項「財務報表與補充資料」一併閱讀。我們依照美國通用會計準則（"GAAP" 或 "U.S. GAAP"）及以美元為單位編製財務報表。
本節討論2025年與2024年之間的年度比較。有關2024年與2023年之間的年度比較，請參閱我們2024年度年報（Form 10-K）中第II項第7項「管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析」，該年報於2025年2月19日提交至美國證券交易委員會（"SEC"）（"Prior Annual Report"）。

我們認為某些因素已對我們的營運結果與財務狀況產生重大影響，且將持續產生重大影響。由於許多這些因素超出我們的控制範圍，且某些因素歷來具有波動性，過去的表現並不一定能代表未來的表現，且很難以任何程度的確定性預測未來表現。此外，可能導致我們實際營運結果或財務狀況與下列所表達或暗示的有重大差異的重要因素，包括但不限於本年度年報中所載的「第1A項「風險因素」」及「為符合1995年私人證券訴訟改革法案之「安全港」條款而設的警示聲明」。
討論期間之營運結果如下：
體積小幅增加 13.8 千公噸，或 1.5%，年增至 948.6 千公噸，主要因 Rubber Carbon Black 分部體積增加，部分抵銷 Specialty Carbon Black 分部體積減少
淨銷售額減少 70.8 百萬美元，或 3.8%，從 2024 年的 1,877.5 百萬美元降至 2025 年的 1,806.7 百萬美元，主要受到原油價格下跌的過渡影響，部分抵銷 Rubber Carbon Black 分部的銷售量增加及有利的匯率影響。
銷貨成本減少約 1.8 百萬美元，或 0.1%，從 2024 年的 1,448.7 百萬美元降至 2025 年的 1,446.9 百萬美元。
毛利率減少 69.0 百萬美元或 16.1%，從 2024 年的 428.8 百萬美元降至 2025 年的 359.8 百萬美元。

paragraphs: 下列風險可能對本公司之業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大不利影響。尚有其他風險與不確定性，本公司目前尚未知悉或認為不重要，但這些風險與不確定性亦可能對本公司之業務運作與財務狀況造成重大影響。

本公司之業務與營運表現與全球經濟狀況有重大關聯。由於碳黑用於多種最終產品，因此碳黑之需求歷來與實質國內生產總值（"GDP"）及總體經濟狀況相關。特別是，本公司銷售之大部分直接與週期性汽車產業有關，且在較小程度上與建設產業有關。因此，本公司某些業務部門會面臨一定程度的週期性。本公司業務性質與龐大之固定資產基礎，使本公司在產品需求下降時，難以迅速降低固定成本，這可能會對本公司之獲利能力造成重大影響。過去全球與區域經濟衰退已導致，且未來也可能導致本公司產品之需求或價格下降，這會降低並進一步降低本公司之營業收入，並可能對本公司之業務、財務狀況、營運成果與現金流造成重大不利影響。
在市場動盪或信貸取得緊縮之期間，本公司可能會面臨應收帳款回收困難、價格壓力與全球或地方業務活動減少等問題。
本公司客戶可能因需求與生產下降、破產、流動性不足、資金不足、營運失敗、不可抗力、困難或其他原因，終止或試圖修改其購買本公司產品的契約。目前能源、金融、經濟與資本市場環境，以及這些及其他領域未來的發展，對本公司績效、財務狀況、業務規模、營運結果與現金流，均產生重大不確定性與風險。
本公司在歐盟的營運對本公司業務具有重大影響，並對客戶而言亦屬重要。若因環境保護法規成本增加、經濟政策不一致與勞動制度僵化等因素，導致歐盟製造業的競爭力持續下降，客戶可能在該地區維持其營運競爭力或失去重要市場份額至其他地區（特別是亞洲）的低成本進口產品。例如，輪胎生產從高成本地區（如歐盟）轉移至低成本地區（如亞洲），可能增加亞洲製造的輪胎出口至歐洲銷售，並導致歐盟輪胎生產減少，進而降低本公司利潤。

此外，美國或其他國家與本公司營運或採購必要物料之國家間貿易關係的變化，或相關緊張關係，可能對本公司業務產生負面影響。個別國家施加額外限制性政策，可能導致本公司營運或業務所涉及國家出現未預期的營運困難。進一步的貿易關係變化與不確定性，以及政府政策（包括實際或威脅性的措施，如關稅、反關稅及其他貿易障礙），已並可能持續影響全球市場與外匯匯率。任何這些情況都可能增加本公司成本，並對本公司財務狀況、營運結果與現金流產生負面影響。
